Market Microstructure Simulator





A Python simulation of an efficient limit order book with Avellaneda-Stoikov market making, modeling how adverse selection from informed traders erodes market-maker profits.





May 20, 2026












Counterfactual Regret Minimization & Poker Simulators





A brief explanation of Counter-Factual Regret Minimzation (CFR) and how it can be used to model Game Theory Optimal (GTO) strategies for various games including rock-paper-scissors and poker along with python simulations opf these.
